CAQI.docs: European Common Air Quality Index. Returns values from 0 upward, where higher values indicate worse air quality. Typically 0-25 is very low, 25-50 is low, 50-75 is medium, 75-100 is high, and >100 is very high.

AQI.docs: US EPA Air Quality Index breakpoint formula applied to PM2.5 and PM10 only. Returns values from 0-500, where higher values indicate worse air quality. **This is not a full EPA AQI** — the official standard covers five pollutant categories and also requires ozone, CO, SO₂, and NO₂ measurements. Based on the [EPA Technical Assistance Document](https://document.airnow.gov/technical-assistance-document-for-the-reporting-of-daily-air-quailty.pdf).
